gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 recognizes the weighted non-orthogonality of the functional factors, but it does not recognize the separate asserted dimension/count defect that T_{0:m_ell-1}V has r_ell entries rather than r_ell^0 entries. The full bundled gold concern is therefore incomplete.

ISSUE-005 concerns the omitted n^3 work in the full-tensor spline construction, whereas the gold issue concerns the total arithmetic complexity of the CP-aware RHOSVD method, including its additional mR log m and mR min{m,R} terms.

Both identify the invalid first error bound caused by using signed xi_k where the triangle inequality requires |xi_k|, including the possibility of a negative right-hand side, and both specify the absolute-value repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The lemma applies a nonnegative absolute-error bound with signed weights instead of absolute weights; the corresponding triangle-inequality steps and bound must use |xi_k|.

component_coverage.gold_component: The first lemma bound and its proof incorrectly use signed xi_k rather than |xi_k|, making the claimed absolute-error bound false for arbitrary real weights.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly derives the absolute-value requirement from the triangle inequality, gives a signed-weight counterexample, identifies the false inequality, and supplies the precise |xi_k| repair.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify that constructing the trivariate spline from arbitrary n^3 input data requires O(n^3) work, so the stated O(m^3(m+n)) estimate understates complexity in the m much smaller than n regime; both give the corrected O(n^3+m^3) form.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The full-tensor spline construction complexity omits the required processing cost of the n^3 input entries and must include an O(n^3+m^3) term in the isotropic case.

component_coverage.gold_component: The trivariate spline construction from n^3 input data has O(n^3) work, so the claimed O(m^3(m+n)) bound is too small and should be replaced by O(n^3+m^3) in the isotropic case.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction identifies both the unavoidable n^3 construction/input cost and the m^3 evaluation cost, explains the underestimated regime, and supplies the corrected complexity term.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-006 concerns swapping long-range and short-range canonical-vector index sets in the range split. It does not diagnose the separate malformed cell endpoints, missing first physical cell, or anisotropic h_1h_2h_3 normalization in the projection-collocation tensor definition.
